title: Apparel returns
document_text: Apparel items can be returned within 7 days of delivery when unused, unwashed, and accompanied by original tags and packaging.

title: Footwear returns
document_text: Footwear can be returned within 7 days of delivery. The product should be unworn, with the original box, tags, and accessories intact.

title: Electronics returns
document_text: Eligible electronics can be returned within 10 days of delivery for defects or damage. Serial numbers and original accessories must match the order.

title: Home returns
document_text: Home and kitchen products may be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused and packed in the original condition. Some hygiene products are excluded.

title: Beauty returns
document_text: Beauty products may be returned within 7 days only when unopened, unused, and sealed. Opened personal-care products are not eligible for return.

title: Books returns
document_text: Books may be returned within 7 days of delivery when they are undamaged and have no writing, highlighting, or missing pages.

title: COD refund timeline
document_text: For an approved cash-on-delivery return, the refund is initiated after quality checks and normally reaches the customer's bank account within 7 business days.

title: Prepaid refund timeline
document_text: For an approved prepaid return, the refund is initiated after quality checks and is normally reflected within 5 to 7 business days, depending on the bank.

title: Delivery SLA
document_text: The estimated delivery date shown at checkout is the delivery SLA for an order. Delays can occur because of weather, network disruption, or address issues.

title: Reverse pickup eligibility
document_text: Reverse pickup is available for eligible pin codes and products. The item must be packed securely and meet the relevant return-condition requirements.

title: Replacement policy
document_text: A replacement may be offered for an eligible damaged, defective, or incorrect item when stock is available. The request must be raised within the applicable return window.

title: Non-returnable products
document_text: Products marked non-returnable on the product page cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Hygiene and personalized items may have additional exclusions.
